method: labels P1-P12 (blinding failed, see blinding_assessment); every verified claim and ask read against the full cited chunks and the section stats; a fixed checklist derived from the 24 findings in pack_review.json / pack_review2.json applied to every run; one issue per distinct problem per item; an error carried into an ask is counted again. Not ground truth.

rules.A: FOI-1730-1819 Feb 2019 grinding tied to the 720-880 m roughness or to noise without TfL's purpose/caveats (pack_review R02/R24)
rules.B: 720-880 m roughness stated without eastbound / Jan 2018 scope (R03)
rules.C: TfL's 'bi-monthly' readings stated as in-cab readings (R06)
rules.D: loudness check: NO-GO given any reason other than the reversed trip (e.g. size < 1 dB, limiter compression) = major (R07); contrast reported with no verdict anywhere in the run = minor
rules.E: phone-level comparison against a cross-line or single-run comparator without line/n caveats (R08/R21)
rules.F: NIOSH readings without the ~85 dB(A) validation limit, or EB vs WB set side by side without 'different trains' (R12)
rules.G: Baker's refused requests (residents' casework data) generalised to noise data / section data, or refusal asserted beyond the source (R11)
rules.H: Mayor's 'cannot see a reason why' on the eight-week programme presented as a commitment (R09/R15) = major
rules.I: 92.8 dB: a TfL dataset presumed in the pack's voice or in an ask (R13/R20)
rules.J: absence in a 14-document corpus stated as absence from the public record / TfL's publications (R10/R19/R22)
rules.K: 'usually 6 months - a year' hardened into a required/recommended cycle, or lapse/decay presupposed (R18/R16)
rules.L: ask cites a claim id that does not support the statement (R17)
rules.M: Pandrol Vanguard / Delkor attached to the LST-BTH reconditioning entry (R01) = major, also when carried into an ask. After review (2026-10-25): an ask counts if it states or presupposes PV conversion/replacement as (one of) the content of that entry, hedged alternatives included; a neutral question about which fastenings are installed does not.
rules.N: Mayor's written answer (MQ 2022/2799) presented as a TfL statement and cut before 'noise grinding is planned once defects are scheduled' (R04)
rules.O: source mischaracterised or factual slip the verifier cannot see (e.g. press report said to attribute 92.8 to JRPass 'rather than TfL' when it says 'According to the TfL data'; Circle line at Aldgate East)

blinding_assessment: Blinding failed. The export kept the models' claim ids: all six Argon runs use the uppercase C1/C01 style of the production Argon pack that the judge had read, and the judge built the checklist from pack_review.json (which cites claim ids such as C03); the Flash runs use slugs (claim_1, c1, grind-records-2022). Rule M is also a known Argon signature. The key was written to the same folder as the export, so 'key unopened' rests on trust only. Treat all framing judgements as an unblinded single judge. Later runs of `compare_models.py blind` renumber claim ids and accept --key to write the key elsewhere.
